```{r}
setwd("data/")

glasser <- fread("glasser360NodeNames.txt", header = FALSE)
yeo <- fread("yeo_in_glasser.txt")
group <- fread("group.txt", header = FALSE)
age <- fread("age.txt", header = FALSE)
sex <- fread("sex.txt", header = FALSE)

gradient1 <- load_gradient("gradient1.txt", "gradient_1") 
gradient2 <- load_gradient("gradient2.txt", "gradient_2") 
gradient3 <- load_gradient("gradient3.txt", "gradient_3")

all <- rbind(gradient1, gradient2, gradient3)
setDT(all)

dt_long <- melt(all, id.vars = c("subject", "group", "gradient", "age", "sex"),
                variable.name = "roi",
                value.name = "gradient_score")

dt_long <- dt_long[, hemi := sapply(str_split(roi, "_"), `[`, 1)]
dt_long[hemi == "Left", hemi := "left"]
dt_long[hemi == "Right", hemi := "right"]
dt_long <- dt_long[, region := sapply(str_split(roi, "_"), `[`, 2)]
dt_long <- dt_long[, roi := NULL]

# add yeo network info
nsubs <- length(unique(dt_long$subject))
ngrad <- length(unique(dt_long$gradient))
nrois <- length(unique(dt_long$region))
dt_long <- dt_long[, yeo := rep(yeo$V1, each = nsubs * ngrad)]
dt_long$yeo <- as.factor(dt_long$yeo)
dt_long[yeo == "1", yeo := "VIS"]
dt_long[yeo == "2", yeo := "SMN"]
dt_long[yeo == "3", yeo := "DAN"]
dt_long[yeo == "4", yeo := "VAN"]
dt_long[yeo == "5", yeo := "LIN"]
dt_long[yeo == "6", yeo := "FPN"]
dt_long[yeo == "7", yeo := "DMN"]

# add visaul stream info
evc_regions <- c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4")
dorsal_regions <- c("V3A", "V3B", "V6", "V6A", "V7", "IPS1")
ventral_regions <- c("V8", "VVC", "PIT", "FFC", "VMV1", "VMV2", "VMV3", "PHA1",
                     "PHA2", "PHA3", "PreS", "ProS", "DVT")
lateral_occ <- c("V3CD", "LO1", "LO2", "LO3", "V4t", "FST", "MT", "MST", "PH")

dt_long[region %in% evc_regions, stream := "evc"]
dt_long[region %in% dorsal_regions, stream := "dorsal"]
dt_long[region %in% ventral_regions, stream := "ventral"]
dt_long[region %in% lateral_occ, stream := "lateral"]
dt_long <- dt_long[, .(mean_score = mean(gradient_score)),
                   by = .(subject, region, group, gradient, yeo, stream)]

visual_dt <- dt_long[!is.na(stream),]
visual_dt[, order := rank(-mean_score), by = .(subject, stream, group, gradient)]

visual_sum <- visual_dt[, .(sum_order = length(.I)),
                        by = .(group, stream, order, region, gradient)]

total_orders <- visual_dt[, .(total_order = .N), by = .(group, stream, region, gradient)]
visual_sum <- merge(visual_sum, total_orders, by = c("group", "stream", "region", "gradient"))
visual_sum[, proportion := sum_order / total_order]
```

```{r}
setwd("../data/gradient_data/")

min_dist_g1 <- fread("min_distance_gradient1.txt")
min_dist_g1$group <- group
min_dist_g1 <- min_dist_g1[, subject := seq(1, length(.I))]
min_dist_g1$gradient <- "gradient 1"

min_dist_g2 <- fread("min_distance_gradient2.txt")
min_dist_g2$group <- group
min_dist_g2 <- min_dist_g2[, subject := seq(1, length(.I))]
min_dist_g2$gradient <- "gradient 2"

                   by = .(subject, variable, group, gradient)]
```

# visual hierarchy

## hierarchy

```{r}
evc <- visual_dt[stream == "evc",]

evc_sum <-
  evc[, .(mean_score = mean(mean_score)), by = .(group, region, gradient)]

figure_a <- ggplot(evc_sum,
                  aes(
                    x = group,
                    y = mean_score,
                    fill = region,
                    colour = region
                  )) +
  geom_point(shape = "-",
             size = 15) +
  ylab("mean gradient scores\n") +
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE)  +
  mytheme +
  facet_wrap(~ gradient, scales = "free")
#figure_a

```

## order

```{r}
figure_b <- ggplot(evc,
                  aes(x = group,
                      y = order,
                      color = region,
                      fill = region)) +
  geom_flat_violin(
    aes(fill = region),
    position = position_nudge(x = .25, y = 0),
    adjust = 1.5,
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = .5,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(x = group, y = order, color = region),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.25),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = .5,
    width = .2,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE)  +
  mytheme +
  xlab("group") +
  ylab("rank\n") +
  facet_grid( ~ gradient)
# figure_b

```

## minimum distance

```{r}
min_dist_g1_long <- melt(min_dist_g1, id.vars = c("group", "subject", "gradient"),
                         value.name = "distance",
                         variable.name = "roi")
min_dist_g1_long <- min_dist_g1_long[, log_score := log(distance)]

fig_g1 <- create_violin_boxplot(
  data = min_dist_g1_long,
  x_var = "roi",
  y_var = "log_score",
  color_var = "group",
  theme = mytheme,
  x_label = "",
  y_label = "log(minimum distance)\n",
  fill_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"),
  color_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71")
)

min_dist_g2_long <- melt(min_dist_g2, id.vars = c("group", "subject", "gradient"),
                         value.name = "distance",
                         variable.name = "roi")
min_dist_g2_long <- min_dist_g2_long[, log_score := log(distance)]

fig_g2 <- create_violin_boxplot(
  data = min_dist_g2_long,
  x_var = "roi",
  y_var = "log_score",
  color_var = "group",
  theme = mytheme,
  x_label = "region",
  y_label = "",
  fill_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"),
  color_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71")
)

min_dist_g3_long <- melt(min_dist_g3, id.vars = c("group", "subject", "gradient"),
                         value.name = "distance",
                         variable.name = "roi")
min_dist_g3_long <- min_dist_g3_long[, log_score := log(distance)]

fig_g3 <- create_violin_boxplot(
  data = min_dist_g3_long,
  x_var = "roi",
  y_var = "log_score",
  color_var = "group",
  theme = mytheme,
  x_label = "",
  y_label = "",
  fill_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71"),
  color_colors = c(SC = "#440154", CB = "#43BF71")
)

all_figs <- ggarrange(figure_a,
                      NULL,
                      figure_b,
                      NULL,
                      ggarrange(fig_g1 + theme(legend.box.margin = margin(r = 20)),
  fig_g2 + theme(
    legend.box.margin = margin(r = 20)),
  fig_g3 + theme(
    legend.box.margin = margin(r = 20)), 
  ncol = 3,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "right",
  labels = c("C", "", "")),
  ncol = 1,
  labels = c("A", "", "B"),
  heights = c(1, 0.15, 1, 0.15, 1),
  align = "v"
)

#all_figs

setwd('../publications/manuscript/figures')
  
tiff("figure_dist.tiff",
     height = 30, width = 26, units = "cm",
     compression = "lzw", res = 500, type = "cairo",
     bg = "white")
all_figs
dev.off()

```

# analysis - minimum distance of regions to each other

## gradient 1

```{r}
model_g1 <- mixed(log(distance) ~ group*roi + (1|subject),
                  min_dist_g1_long)
model_g1
```

```{r}
emm_int <- emmeans(model_g1, ~ group | roi, type = "response")
emm_int
```

```{r}
update(pairs(emm_int), adjust = "holm", by = NULL)
```

```{r}
evc_wide <- dcast(evc, subject + group + gradient ~ region, value.var = "mean_score")
# Calculate differences between all region combinations
region_cols <- setdiff(names(evc_wide), c("subject", "group", "gradient"))
combs <- combn(region_cols, 2, simplify = FALSE)

for (comb in combs) {
  col_name <- paste("diff", comb[2], comb[1], sep = "_")
  evc_wide[, (col_name) := get(comb[2]) - get(comb[1])]
}

diff_long <- melt(evc_wide, 
                  id.vars = c("subject", "gradient", "group"), 
                  measure.vars = patterns("^diff_"), 
                  variable.name = "comparison", 
                  value.name = "diff_mean_score")



figure1 <- ggplot(diff_long,
                  aes(
                    x = comparison,
                    y = diff_mean_score,
                    color = group,
                    fill = group
                  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    SC = "#440154",
    CB = "#43BF71",
    LB = "#23888E"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    SC = "#440154",
    CB = "#43BF71",
    LB = "#23888E"
  )) +
  geom_flat_violin(
    aes(fill = group),
    position = position_nudge(x = .25, y = 0),
    adjust = 1.5,
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = .5,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(x = comparison, y = diff_mean_score, color = group),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.25),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = .5,
    width = .2,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  mytheme +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("rank") +
  facet_wrap(~ gradient, scales = "free") +
  coord_flip()
figure1

setwd('../publications/manuscript/figures')
  
tiff("figure_rank2_1.tiff",
     height = 10, width = 26, units = "cm",
     compression = "lzw", res = 500, type = "cairo",
     bg = "transparent")
figure1
dev.off()
```

# dorsal stream - expected hierarchy

V1, V2, V3, V3A, V3B, V6, V6A, V7, IPS

```{r}
dorsal <- visual_dt[stream == "dorsal" | stream == "evc",]
dorsal$region <- ordered(dorsal$region, 
                         levels = c("V1", "V2", "V3","V3A", "V3B", "V6", "V6A", "V7", "IPS1"))

dorsal <- dcast(dorsal, subject + group ~ region, value.var = "mean_score")

cb <- dorsal[group == "CB",  ]
cb <- cb[, c("subject", "group", "stream") := NULL]

corrplot(cor(cb))
```

```{r}
sc <- dorsal[group == "SC",  ]
sc <- sc[, c("subject", "group", "stream") := NULL]

corrplot(cor(sc))
```

```{r}
result <- visual_dt[, {
  combinations <- combn(unique(region), 2, simplify = FALSE)
  differences <- lapply(combinations, function(x) {
    diff <- mean_score[region == x[1]] - mean_score[region == x[2]]
    data.table(region1 = x[1], region2 = x[2], distance = diff)
  })
  rbindlist(differences)
}, by = .(subject, group)]
```

```{r}
model_all <- mixed(distance ~region1*group + (1|subject),
                   data = result)
model_all
```

```{r}
emm_groupxroi <- emmeans(model_all, ~ region1 | group)
emm_groupxroi
```
